assets.name: rooms-bunny
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation SPRITE SHEET for a Phaser paper hotel game. Reinterpret the supplied REFERENCES as one isolated strawberry pink origami room with a cute white bunny with long ears resident. Match the reference's richly detailed handmade paper diorama: real paper fibers, triangular crease facets, carved arched deep dark window, tiny white and pink flowers, layered green leaves and vines, burgundy paper curtains, warm golden hanging lantern, tactile cardboard edges, dimensional soft shadow inside the window. This is beautifully photographed miniature papercraft, colorful and intricate, NOT flat vector illustration.
OUTPUT: one wide 2:1 PNG with genuine transparent background, preferably 1536x768. EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows, EIGHT equally sized square cells, no borders, labels, text or padding between cells. Each cell has ONE room at the SAME scale and center, frontal orthographic view. Pixel-aligned repeated facade for frames 3 through 7, with exterior wall flush to the four cell edges so complete rooms can tile next to each other. Do not draw a grid. All artwork stays within its cell.
READING ORDER frame0 top-left: folded small strawberry pink cube with tiny guest emblem, transparent surrounding it; frame1: cube unfolding into a cross of folded paper panels, transparent surrounds; frame2: nearly assembled square room with open side flaps and window visible; frame3: complete square room with resident looking out happily; frame4 (second row left): IDENTICAL complete facade but guest eyes closed blinking; frame5: identical facade, guest reading a small blue book; frame6: identical facade, guest waving one paw/hand; frame7: identical facade, guest dozing behind a pillow. Facade and flowers stay absolutely still in frames3-7, change only guest pose. Single room/window per cell, not a tower, no sky, no UI, no other species. Grounded craft detail and expressive face.

assets.name: actors
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation SPRITE SHEET for Phaser, derived from these reference images. Match the rich photographic handmade origami diorama, tactile creased and fibered colored paper, dimensional shading, whimsical animals. Generate ONE square transparent PNG sprite sheet, ideally1536x1536, EXACT 4x4 grid of sixteen equally sized square cells, no drawn grid, no text, no labels. Each character is isolated on genuine alpha transparency and stays fully within its cell with a consistent 6% margin, no props extend to another cell.
Row1: the SAME adorable white and lavender Copycat magician wearing a rich purple folded-paper cape with tiny gold stars and gold bell. Four readable animation poses left to right: looking through a small brass spyglass, pressing a large wooden paw stamp onto folded paper, throwing a folded paper parcel rightwards, cheering with raised paw and flying cape. Match the Copycat in reference2 closely.
Row2: pink faceted paper hot-air balloon with white bunny emblem and tiny brown hanging basket. Four subtly different motion frames of the SAME balloon: straight, leaning a few degrees left, straight with basket slightly lifted, leaning a few degrees right.
Row3: leaf green faceted paper hot-air balloon with cute frog emblem and basket, same four poses.
Row4: warm orange faceted paper hot-air balloon with cute cat emblem and basket, same four poses.
The balloons are portrait shaped and fill80% cellheight. Keep all frame centers and scale consistent. Real paper folds, intricate details, soft internal shadows, warm light, vivid colors. No checkerboard baked in, no background scene, no typography.

assets.name: sky
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless-looking sky backdrop for a portrait-oriented paper hotel game. Rework the ENVIRONMENT ONLY from supplied references. Deliver a tall 2:3 image, preferably1024x1536. A vibrant azure blue textured craft-paper sky photographed as a dimensional handmade origami diorama. Many bright white softly shaded faceted folded-paper clouds of different sizes, drifting around the outer edges. Along the left and right edges: three tiny floating rock islands at varied heights, mossy green paper tops, dark geometric stone facets, folded evergreen trees, one tiny cream cottage with red roof, one distant windmill, and a narrow flowing blue paper waterfall. Intricate paper fibers, creases and layered cut-paper shadows. Main central40% of frame should remain calm plain blue sky from top to bottom to put a tall hotel over it. Small scenery at the sides only; no tower, no hotel, no animals, no giant foreground objects, no interface, no cards, no words, no border. Match the references' cheerful detailed tactile miniature quality and saturated sky, no vector aesthetic, no beige wash.

assets.name: props
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated game scenery and prop SPRITE ATLAS matching the supplied detailed origami hotel references. One wide2:1 transparent PNG, 4 columns by2 rows of EIGHT equal square cells, no drawn grid, labels, text or UI. Photographed richly textured handmade paper diorama, folds and fibers, vivid happy colors, miniature craft realism, soft dimensional internal shadows. Each object fits fully within its own cell with12% clear margin.
Row1 left to right: (0) white faceted low wide origami cloud, (1) floating hotel foundation island: flat broad green grassy tabletop above faceted greyblue hanging rock with tiny trees only on outer edges, leave middle tabletop empty, front orthographic, (2) the hotel's unfinished construction platform: a low wide horizontal kraft cardboard tray, front edge visible and two short partly folded upright tabs at the corners, absolutely no roof or house on it, (3) a wide triangular dark teal origami hotel roof with golden trim, tiny chimney and gold star finial, front view.
Row2 left to right: (4) mysterious folded golden-yellow paper parcel box with violet ribbon and little white star seal, (5) golden bell with lavender bow and two tiny goldstars, (6) a thick shiny faceted gold paper coin with raised star, (7) a bright pink folded origami heart.
Genuine alpha transparency around each individual sprite. Strong readable silhouettes. Islands, clouds, platform, roof are wider than tall but stay inside square cells. Style matches the detailed tactile references, not flat vector art.
